description: This header defines a mock implementation of the WPEFramework::PluginHost::IFactories interface using Google Mock. It provides mocked methods for creating web request, response, file body, and JSON RPC message objects, and initializes default behaviors for these methods.

classes.name: FactoriesImplementation
classes.description: A mock class implementing the IFactories interface for testing purposes, providing mocked web factory methods with preset default behaviors.

methods.name: FactoriesImplementation
methods.description: Constructor initializing default behaviors for the mocked methods.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Returns a mocked web request object.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Returns a mocked web response object.

methods.name: FileBody
methods.description: Returns a mocked web file body object.

methods.name: JSONRPC
methods.description: Returns a mocked JSON RPC web object.
